result.summary: Refactors transaction construction in `mempool_tests.cpp` to use declarative `CTxIn` and `CTxOut` initializer lists instead of manual vector resizing and field-by-field assignment. The constructed transactions and test behaviors remain unchanged.
result.problem: Setting up test transactions by resizing vectors and assigning input and output fields imperatively is verbose and harder to read than declarative initialization.
evidence: Part of #36692 tracking declarative construction of test data.
Author states declarative syntax makes constructed transactions easier to read and prepares call sites for potential CTransaction constructors under discussion in #36696.
result.changed_since_previous: Dropped changes to the `mempool_eviction` benchmark and `rbf_tests` to avoid conflicts with #36521, narrowing the PR strictly to `mempool_tests.cpp`.
result.card: This PR refactors transaction creation in mempool_tests to use declarative CTxIn and CTxOut constructor calls rather than manual vector resizing and field assignments. Part of issue #36692, it aims to improve test readability and prepare test call sites for direct CTransaction constructors. The change is test-only and does not alter the generated transactions.

risk.why: Touches only unit test transaction setup without modifying production code.
